headline: § 1121. Immunizations required prior to attending school and child care facilities
blurb: This Vermont law, added in 1979, says a student may not enroll in a Vermont school unless the school has a record showing the student got the required immunizations.

headline: Pertussis Outbreak -- Vermont, 1996
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: Vermont identified 280 whooping cough cases across the state in 1996, and 46% of them were in people ages 10 to 19.

headline: Act No. 157 (S.199). Health; immunizations
source: Vermont General Assembly, Summary of the 2012 Acts and Resolves
blurb: This Vermont law, in effect July 1, 2012, required parents who claim a religious or philosophical exemption from school shots to sign a statement each year on a state health department form.

headline: Act No. 37 (H.98). Health; public health; reportable diseases
blurb: This 2015 Vermont law removed the philosophical exemption from the immunizations required for school and child care, starting July 1, 2016.

headline: Health Department Confirms Case of Measles in Vermont
blurb: The Vermont Department of Health confirmed a measles case in a person visiting Vermont with an international group program, the first confirmed case in the state since 2018.

headline: Vermont Department of Health Confirms Case of Measles
blurb: The Vermont Department of Health confirmed measles in a school-aged child in Lamoille County who became sick after traveling internationally, the first case in Vermont in 2025.
